svg.title: fixed-streaming
svg.desc: Toy 24×24 masks with a 6-token window. Window only: once token 0 leaves the cache, Llama-2-13B perplexity on PG19 jumps to 5158.07 (cache 1024). StreamingLLM keeps the first 4 tokens as sinks plus 1020 recent tokens: perplexity 5.40. Positions are assigned inside the cache: text positions 0,1,2,3,6,7,8 and new token 9 become 0 to 7. The cache stays 4 + W records: 1 GiB for Llama-2-7B with 2,048 slots, at any length.

text.font-family: STIX Two Math,Cambria Math,Times New Roman,serif

svg.text: pos(j) = rank of j inside the cache
